name: O MAKER MINE
source:
To escape the pain of my life poorly lived, I dream. 

There is a new person in my dreams.

She is going to be the end of me.

[From [url=https://ourashendoll.itch.io/o-maker-mine]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了逃避糟糕人生带来的痛楚，我沉溺于梦境。

我的梦里多了一个陌生人。

她将会成为我的终结。

[摘自[url=https://ourashendoll.itch.io/o-maker-mine]itch.io[/url]]
